response: Yes, preoperative anemia has been shown to adversely affect outcomes in colon and rectal surgery. Studies have found that patients with preoperative anemia are at increased risk of postoperative complications, such as infection, transfusion requirements, and longer hospital stays. Additionally, anemia has been associated with higher rates of morbidity and mortality, as well as decreased overall survival rates. It is essential to identify and manage anemia before surgery to optimize patient outcomes.
